newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UAE Health Ministry proceeds with plans to place nationals in technical and managerial posts.
- Foreign firms prepare feasibility studies for a free zone in Ras Al-Khaimah.
- Abu Dhabi Development Fund extends loans worth 6.3 billion dirhams in the year to August.
- New 69 million dirham hospital to open in Dubai in April.
- UAE nationals, expatriates condemn U.S. missile strikes on Iraq.
- Officials to discuss extension of amnesty deadline for UAE residency regulation violators.
- Rwanda seeks UAE assistance in restructuring.
